Tan Lines
/

Made for Jeffrey Tan. Live scores, rankings and bios come from ESPN's public tennis feed. Career history, serve and return statistics and past rankings come from Jeff Sackmann's open tennis database (Tennis Abstract), used under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, joined to the live feed and summarised here; the career data built into this page and the history files it loads carry the same licence, for non-commercial use. The ITF, WTA 125 and qualifying results come from the same database. Charting profiles and point-by-point match charts come from the Match Charting Project (Jeff Sackmann / Tennis Abstract, volunteer-charted), also CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, summarised here. Elo ratings, forecasts, streaks, splits and simulations are worked out on this page from those results.

Keys: / find a player · 1–5 switch views · Esc close a panel. Surface and tier labels are matched from the history database; WTA 125 events have no surface tag. On a phone, use Share, then Add to Home Screen, to keep Tan Lines as an app.
